items.title: Kidney Beam: free digital kidney programme opens to North London residents
items.summary: NHS West and North London ICB has commissioned the Kidney Beam 12-week virtual programme (exercise, education, dietary advice, health coaching) for residents of Barnet, Camden, Enfield, Haringey and Islington. Early-stage patients can self-register; advanced disease via Royal Free referral.

items.title: Procurement panel reviews Royal Devon's tertiary renal managed service award
items.summary: The Independent Patient Choice and Procurement Panel has published its review (case CR0064-26) of a proposed contract award for fully managed facility services and nursing services for tertiary renal services in Devon and Somerset. NHS England published the report on 17 November 2026.
